verdict.rationale: Entra ID documents device registration and join, and says device identities are the prerequisite for device-based Conditional Access and for MDM with the Microsoft Intune family. That is a documented MDM integration tied to identity, plus identity-linked device policy enforcement. Entra itself does not do the device management; that is delegated to Intune. Missing for 10: any evidence of remote lock/wipe, documentation of the MDM enrollment flow itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, devices are managed from the same platform or a documented MDM integration — enrollment, policy enforcement, and remote lock/wipe tied to identity

citations.quote: Device identities are a prerequisite for scenarios like device-based Conditional Access policies and Mobile Device Management with the Microsoft Intune family of products.
Registering and joining devices to Microsoft Entra ID gives users Seamless Sign-on (SSO) to cloud-based resources.
